description: Todo example app (examples/todo): HTTP traffic, registrations, authentication, todos and audit outbox delivery.

panels.title: Audit outbox oldest age
panels.description: Oldest undelivered audit entry across outboxes. /health turns 503 past TODO_OUTBOX_MAX_AGE_SECONDS (300 s by default).

panels.title: Audit backlog
panels.description: Audit entries committed but not yet delivered to the audit backend.

targets.expr: sum by (handler, method) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$job", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (handler, method) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Registrations by outcome
panels.description: success · replayed (Idempotency-Key retry) · email_taken · idempotency_key_reused · error

panels.title: Authentication attempts by outcome
panels.description: API-token authentication: success · missing · invalid · error (storage down)

panels.title: Invalid-token ratio
panels.description: Share of authentication attempts with an unknown token. A spike suggests credential stuffing or a leaked, rotated token.

panels.title: Users storage failures
panels.description: Operations that failed because the database was unavailable (StorageUnavailableError).

panels.title: Todo creation errors
panels.description: Creations that failed because storage was unavailable.

panels.title: Oldest undelivered entry
panels.description: Age of the oldest audit entry waiting for delivery, per outbox. Alert fires above 300 s for 5 minutes.

panels.title: Pending entries
panels.description: Audit entries committed with their change but not yet accepted by the audit backend.

panels.title: Delivered
panels.description: Audit entries the relay delivered to the audit backend.

panels.title: Delivery failures
panels.description: Failed delivery attempts. The entry stays in the outbox and is retried; sustained failures mean the audit sink is down.
